behaviour: Documents the page fields of the `.excalidraw` file format.
rules: A `### Pages` section is inserted before `## Excalidraw clipboard format`: elements carry an optional `pageId`; `appState.pages` is an array of `{ id, name, index, version, versionNonce, isDeleted }` ordered by `index` (a fractional-index key; deleted pages are tombstones); `appState.activePageId` and `appState.pageViewports` (`{ [pageId]: { scrollX, scrollY, zoom } }` for non-active pages).

A table states the restore rules: no pages means one default page `page-1` named "Page 1"; duplicate ids keep the first; unknown `activePageId` falls back to the first visible page; an element with a missing or unknown `pageId` moves to the active page; cross-page bindings, bound text and frame membership are cut.
It states that the format version stays 2 and that older readers show every page's elements on one canvas.
